svg.title: Aperture Chat — a 75-second tour of the live product in light and dark mode
svg.desc: Real screens captured from the current Aperture Chat deployment: a research prompt is typed and sent, a five-step work trace runs to completion, a long cited answer with tables arrives, an approved image model generates a hero image inside the conversation, and the tour continues through the model picker, session details, Drafts with export, Knowledge and Tools governance, the Admin Console, and the Platform Owner Console, ending on: Your models. Your keys. Your audit trail.

g.text: A substantial request, typed in full
Five steps, visible as they run
Ten cited sources — NIST, ISO, EUR-Lex, FTC
Routing to an approved image model
The image lands in the conversation
Tokens and context, in the open
The governed AI workspace — on your own infrastructure
REAL PRODUCT · CAPTURED LIVE · LIGHT + DARK
Your models. Your keys. Your audit trail.
